text:
marta: quick thought — what if node sidecars emit implicit degrade signals (latency spike / KV miss surge) and can request an autofallback locally?
kevin: sidecar voting could be low-latency, but how do we keep auditability? :thinking_face:
ryan: agree on speed, but need single source of truth. we must tie sidecar requests to a decision_id for replay.
jess: sidecar emits a compact envelope to the pipeline, e.g. {source:sidecar-az1, trigger:kv_miss, val:0.72, request:degrade} and we log it.
marta: UX: console must surface compact cards, with one-click expand to see the 30s surrounding signals and the decision trace. not a firehose.
kevin: proposed inbox card: time, service, trigger, confidence, one-click expand -> shows signals + rollout response.
ryan: we should tag requests as implicit vs explicit and show the heuristic name. otherwise debugging is painful.
jess: error triggers too — sidecars seeing downstream 5xxs could request degrade, but require threshold + cooldown.
marta: add a toggle in rollout policy: "allow sidecar-implicit fallback" with threshold, cooldown, notify-level. default off for SLA customers.
ops-bot: deploy-bot notes: sidecar metrics already indexed under sidecar.* but no decision_id attached.
jess: add decision_id header to sidecar emits; sidecar includes it when calling rollout API so traces/logs link up.
kevin: audit UX: timeline view filterable by decision_id, operator, service, reason. default shows only escalations. full view shows all.
marta: split-brain risk: two sidecars flip-flopping. need hysteresis + global arbiter for conflicts. console should show "requested by X, applied by Y".
ryan: arbitration model: sidecar requests on decisions.request topic, arbiter replies on decisions.response with accepted|rejected|deferred. console shows who applied it.
jess: operator override: allow sticky override with TTL and required short annotation in modal. retention: audit events for 90 days, exportable.
sam: security: sidecars need mTLS + node signer tokens; audit should log cert thumbprint. pilot behind feature flag; metrics-only mode first.
kevin: action items: 1) eng-runtime: add decision_id header + kafka topic (owner: jess, due EOW) 2) eng-platform: arbiter API + audit schema (owner: ryan, due next Wed) 3) ux: inbox card + timeline mock (owner: kevin, due next Tue) 4) security: cert thumbprint + perms (owner: sam)
marta: consensus to pilot in single infra pool with metrics-only mode first. will draft RFC and UX flows. thanks all. :raised_hands:
ops-bot: NOTE: created ticket INFRA-1129 for sidecar decision infra.
